description: Create a new UTF-8 text file. The operation fails if the file already exists. Paths are workspace-relative in every approval posture.

propertyDescriptions.content: The complete UTF-8 text to write to the new file.
propertyDescriptions.encoding: The text encoding to use for the new file.

guidance: create_file creates a new file and must not overwrite an existing file. Absolute host paths are not accepted.
